title: Static at Cragmoor Hall
theme: Looking for the real explanation before jumping to the scary one, and judging people by what they do rather than rumor
premise: Static at Cragmoor Hall. New transfer student Rowan Finch hears a steady knocking in the old dorm wing at Cragmoor Hall every night at the same hour, and the other students swear the building is haunted. Rowan and roommate Dessa Okafor trace the sound through the walls, turning up a founder's hidden workshop and a secret that a current student has been guarding, not a ghost.

characters: Rowan Finch, thirteen, a new transfer who likes puzzles more than people
Dessa Okafor, Rowan's roommate, who has lived at the school for years
Theo Marsh, an older student who keeps to himself and knows more than he says
Mr. Pell, the groundskeeper who has worked at Cragmoor Hall longest
facts: Cragmoor Hall is an invented boarding school on a foggy mountain, built over a hundred years ago by a founder named Augusta Cragmoor
The knocking comes from the old dorm wing's wall, always at the same hour each night
The school keeps old maintenance tunnels that most students are not told about
avoid: violence, gore or anyone being badly hurt
real brands, companies, places or real people
any real religion, god, sacred rite, ghost or other supernatural being presented as real
the mystery resolves with a real, human, physical explanation; nothing in the story is ever confirmed to be a ghost or curse
